text: しかし　＊は　さわいでいて　ねむらない！

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is going on now. Here it is itself in the て-form to lead into the next part. さわいでいて = 'is making an uproar, and so'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.span: さわいでいて　ねむらない
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins two parts, the first being the reason for the second. さわいでいて　ねむらない = 'is making an uproar, so it won't sleep'.
